en.compliance.ovw_score_formula: Score = Σ(weight × status) / Σ weight × 100 — passing 1 · attention ½ · failing 0 · n/a does not count. Self-attested items are always listed separately, so a green number never promises more than the tooling has seen. The figures support your ISMS, internal auditor and certification body — they do not replace them.
